answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that vests slowly, like a dune that only holds its shape grain by grain: a new identity posts a bond that unlocks over weeks of verified work, while peers hold a lantern on suspicious clusters by randomly auditing task receipts. A fake that fails an audit forfeits its bond, and the loss ripples to any identity that vouched for it, so spawning thousands of sybils costs real money per identity instead of being free.
